bg-36-01.hint: Where are you meeting your friend right now?
bg-36-01.why: Location question uses 어디: 어디에서 만나요.

bg-36-01.q: Write a sentence asking what this is using 이거 and 뭐예요.
bg-36-01.why: 뭐 (what) is commonly used in speech: 이거 뭐예요?

steps.en: Where are you going right now?
Where are you going so urgently in such a hurry right now?

ko: 거리에서 길을 잃어서 지나가는 사람에게 길을 물어보았어요.
그분이 친절하게 길을 가르쳐 주셔서 역을 쉽게 찾았어요.
en: I was lost on the street, so I asked a passerby for directions.
"Excuse me, where is the subway station?"
That person kindly taught me the way, so I found the station easily.

bg-36-01.q: What did the writer ask the passerby?
options: Where the subway station is (지하철역이 어디에 있어요?)

bg-36-01.why: The text says '친절하게 길을 가르쳐 주셔서'.

items: I can ask about things (뭐), people (누구/누가), and places (어디).
I can ask for directions politely on the street.

bg-36-02.hint: How do you go to school every day?
bg-36-02.why: Questioning method or transportation uses 어떻게: 어떻게 가요.

bg-36-02.q: Write a sentence asking when your friend's birthday is using 생일이 and 언제예요.
bg-36-02.why: 언제 already includes temporal meaning; do not attach 에 to it: 생일이 언제예요?

steps.en: How do you go to the company?
How do you go to the company by subway every morning?

ko: 오늘 아침에 민수 씨가 회사에 평소보다 늦게 도착했어요.
민수 씨는 지하철 고장 때문에 어떻게 출근했는지 자세히 설명했어요.
en: This morning Minsu arrived at the company later than usual.
The department manager asked the reason why he was late.
Minsu explained in detail how he commuted because of the subway breakdown.

bg-36-02.q: What did the manager ask Minsu?
bg-36-02.why: The text states '왜 늦었는지 이유를 물어보셨어요'.

items: I can ask about time (언제), reasons (왜), and methods/transportation (어떻게).
I can avoid double particle errors like 언제에.

bg-36-03.hint: How much are these three apples?

bg-36-03.q: Write a sentence asking which country someone came from using 어느 나라에서 and 왔어요.
bg-36-03.why: Selecting from a set of existing countries takes 어느: 어느 나라에서 왔어요?

base.en: What kind of food do you like?

steps.en: Among Korean dishes, what kind of food do you like?

tokens: 매운 한국 요리 중에서 무슨 음식을
steps.en: Among spicy Korean dishes, what kind of food do you like the most?

ko: 한국어 수업 첫날에 세계 여러 나라에서 온 친구들과 만났어요.
선생님이 학생들에게 어느 나라에서 왔는지 한 사람씩 물어보셨어요.
그리고 주말에 무슨 음식을 먹었는지 서로 이야기하는 시간을 가졌어요.
en: On the first day of Korean class, I met friends from various countries around the world.
The teacher asked students one by one which country they came from.
And we had time to talk with each other about what food we ate on the weekend.

bg-36-03.q: What did the teacher ask each student on the first day?
options: Which country they came from (어느 나라에서 왔는지)
bg-36-03.why: The text says '어느 나라에서 왔는지 한 사람씩 물어보셨어요'.

bg-36-03.q: What did the students share about their weekend?
options: What food they ate (무슨 음식을 먹었는지)
bg-36-03.why: The text mentions '무슨 음식을 먹었는지 서로 이야기하는 시간'.

items: I can ask prices using 얼마예요.
I can clearly distinguish 무슨 (category), 어떤 (character/trait), and 어느 (choice from set).

bg-36-04.why: Choosing from world nations takes 어느: 어느 나라에서 오셨어요.

bg-36-04.q: Write a sentence asking what kind of food you like using 무슨 음식을 and 좋아해요.
bg-36-04.why: Asking about open item categories uses 무슨: 무슨 음식을 좋아해요?

bg-36-04.q: Fix the incorrect question word used when asking someone's nationality.
bg-36-04.wrong: 친구에게 무슨 나라에서 왔어요 하고 물었어요.
answers: 친구에게 어느 나라에서 왔어요 하고 물었어요.
친구에게 어느 나라에서 왔어요 하고 물었어요
bg-36-04.hint: Selecting from a known set of world nations requires 어느: 어느 나라.
bg-36-04.why: Use 어느 for selections among distinct options: 어느 나라에서 왔어요.

a.d: Asks for general category, name, or content (무슨 음식, 무슨 책, 무슨 일).
ex: **무슨** 노래를 들어요? — What song are you listening to?

b.d: Used when choosing one option out of a limited or existing group (어느 나라, 어느 것, 어느 쪽).
ex: **어느** 나라 사람이에요? — Which country are you from?

bg-36-04.tip: Use 무슨 for open names/categories; use 어느 for picking from available options.

steps.en: Who made this sweet birthday cake themselves?

ko: 주말에 친구와 쇼핑몰에 가서 마음에 드는 가방을 구경했어요.
직원에게 이 가방이 얼마인지 묻고 다른 색상도 있는지 확인했어요.
친구가 어느 쪽 가방이 더 예쁜지 함께 골라 주어서 마음에 드는 것을 샀어요.
en: On the weekend I went to the shopping mall with a friend and browsed bags that caught my eye.
I asked the clerk how much this bag was and checked if there were other colors.
My friend helped pick which side's bag was prettier, so I bought one I liked.

bg-36-04.q: What did the writer ask the store clerk?
bg-36-04.why: The text says '직원에게 이 가방이 얼마인지 묻고'.

bg-36-04.q: What did the friend help with?
options: Helped pick which bag was prettier
bg-36-04.why: The text states '친구가 어느 쪽 가방이 더 예쁜지 함께 골라 주어서'.

items: I can masterfully use all 10 Korean question words in everyday communication.
I can distinguish nuanced determiners (무슨, 어떤, 어느, 얼마) without confusing them.
